prompt:
Edit paint_mask_guide.png using design_reference.png as material/detail reference and icon_x8.png as colour reference (ignore magenta). Produce ONE transparent PNG, 1536x2048, 3:4 canvas. Precisely preserve the guide's 3 columns by FOUR rows of 512-square cells and every object position, size, silhouette, orientation, gap and opening. Do not reinterpret the view names or rotate views: match the actual guide pixels. Rows 1-2 contain five views; rows 3-4 repeat those exact five views. Column 3 of rows 2 and 4 stays fully transparent. Paint grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.
Rows 1-2: unlit base colour of a dark-brown quilted leather doublet with high round collar, long padded sleeves, wrap front crossing from left shoulder to waist, thin leather waist cord, fine diagonal quilting seams, long front-split skirt, paler worn leather edging at hem and cuffs. Follow approved design reference details scaled to each view, original icon colours. Leather quilting is leather. No lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections, glow, ground, outlines or text. Keep openings exactly as guide, transparent.
Rows 3-4: MATERIAL MASK, identical five guide silhouettes filled FLAT pure material colours only, no shading, textures, outlines or antialiased colour blends inside. #FF0000 every metal part; #00FF00 every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur; #0000FF every cloth part (cloth quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair; #000000 every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass. This is a leather doublet with leather padding, leather trim and explicitly leather waist cord: green for those leather parts; blue only for actual cloth lining visible on model. Every silhouette pixel exactly one material colour, nothing outside silhouettes. All guide gaps and openings remain fully transparent. Transparent background, no checkerboard painted into image.
CRITICAL CORRECTION: material mask must have clean exact object silhouettes, with ZERO green spill, mist, speckles or paint outside the model. Lower half is five flat solid pure-green silhouette cutouts matching the original guide alpha exactly, with transparent holes, NOT green shaded renders and NOT green backgrounds. No internal linework in the masks. Preserve all spacing and transparent areas. The previous attempt had large erroneous green clouds outside the lower objects; avoid that completely. Use original guide as absolute silhouette authority.
